items.summary: The Miami Hurricanes rebounded from their first loss by defeating Duke and moving closer to an ACC Championship Game berth. Darian Mensah, Javian Mallory and Cooper Barkate powered an offense that scored on seven consecutive drives, while Xavier Lucas delivered a key interception. Still, pass-rush and offensive-line concerns remain.

Mensah threw for 382 yards, Javian Mallory produced 150 total yards and three touchdowns and Cooper Barkate topped 100 receiving yards, but line play and underneath coverage remained concerns.
